name: Raja Krishnamoorthi
notes: Campaign site rajaforcongress.com now redirects (301) to rajaforil.com, which did not resolve (DNS not found), so no campaign X link could be confirmed. Vote Smart and WTTW pages returned 403. Unconfirmed lead from a search summary only: @RajaForCongress (from an older candidate profile). He ran for US Senate in 2026, so a Senate-campaign handle may also exist.

name: Janice D. Schakowsky

accounts.evidence: The Schakowsky for Congress campaign site (footer: 'Paid for and authorized by Schakowsky for Congress') links twitter.com/RepSchakowsky with a follow button.

notes: The campaign site looks old and not recently updated; despite being linked from the campaign site, the 'Rep' prefix suggests @RepSchakowsky may be or have been an official-office account, and it may be inactive. The handle on file (janschakowsky) is likely her main account. She did not seek reelection in 2026. LegiStorm says it has a campaign X link but the URL was not shown.
